name: front back leg raises
description: A standing leg swing forward and backward, loosening the hips. A nice warm-up for the hips and hamstrings.
instructions: Stand tall next to a wall or support and hold on with one hand.
Swing your outside leg forward with a straight knee.
Swing it back behind you, squeezing your glute.
Keep your torso upright and avoid arching your lower back.
Do all reps on one side, then turn around and switch legs.
